_source: Captured from the reference: PHPMailer::getTranslations() on a fresh mailer (base) and on WP_PHPMailer (wordpress), English.

base.buggy_php: Your version of PHP is affected by a bug that may result in corrupted messages. To fix it, switch to sending using SMTP, disable the mail.add_x_header option in your php.ini, switch to macOS or Linux, or upgrade your PHP to version 7.0.17+ or 7.1.3+.
base.connect_host: SMTP Error: Could not connect to SMTP host.
base.file_open: File Error: Could not open file:
base.provide_address: You must provide at least one recipient email address.
base.recipients_failed: SMTP Error: The following recipients failed:
base.no_smtputf8: Server does not support SMTPUTF8 needed to send to Unicode addresses
base.imap_recommended: Using simplified address parser is not recommended. Install the PHP IMAP extension for full RFC822 parsing.
